description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate pet shop objects arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a cute capsule gacha machine with a glass dome full of colorful capsules, a paw print emblem and a turning crank, a plain cream pet egg with brown spots, a blue pet egg with silver star pattern, a purple pet egg with glowing gold swirl cracks. Bottom row: a radiant golden pet egg with rainbow sparkles and a tiny crown pattern, a pink gift box with a ribbon bow and paw print, a round cushioned pet bed with a soft pillow, a wooden pet food bowl filled with kibble. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm cute colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters, no animals, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
